On good-to-great he is the purest case available: he rejected the rescue framing unprompted — 'maybe it would be much easier if I said, I'm 15 or 20 pounds overweight, want to lose. That's my goal. I really don't' — and defined the ask as mastery and continued progression. Not deconditioned is trivially met at 5'10" and 182 lb with nine marathons behind him and 200 to 300 push-ups per session. The single miss is neglected_health, and it is a miss by exceeding the criterion rather than falling short of it: health is not the neglected area of this man's life, it is a six-year daily practice with two paid coaches, seven to eight and a half hours of tracked sleep and no junk food. Scored core because he meets essentially all of the criteria as written and the one exception is directionally favourable. The finding worth carrying to the rollup is the comparison inside this single day: the most ICP-core prospect on the rep's calendar did not close, while the prospect with no established occupation who was checking a credit card limit paid $6,000 in full. Read alongside the existing observations in icp.json, this is further evidence that the stated ICP describes who the company wants rather than who converts, and it suggests the practical differentiator on these calls is not fit but process — this prospect asked for a contract, got one read aloud, and was never asked for the card a second time.
